== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Takeel (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Takeel]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ds-takeel/ SWCCGcards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ds_Takeel.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>a0758ff3acc81c0a049492ebd06e86c2136276e87892317169e648e6beeb86b4</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
